execution_policy: No networking/backend entry is EXECUTED unless a completed experiment record with evidence is attached. Source/vendor research establishes benchmark eligibility only; production preference requires frozen workload, runtime, pricing, privacy/security and portability evidence.

benchmarks.name: BYJTT dedicated server hosting and orchestration

entries.name: Heroic Labs Nakama
entries.license: Pinned open-source Nakama repository is Apache-2.0; Heroic Cloud and enterprise/cluster services have separate commercial terms.
entries.notes: v3.40.0 release commit. Benchmark meta/backend first and server-authoritative match logic where appropriate. Session-based docs expose FleetManager integrations including GameLift and Edgegap; benchmark maintained bridges before custom allocator glue. Physics-heavy simulation may still belong in a separate headless server. No execution claim.

entries.name: Colyseus
entries.license: Pinned repository is MIT; managed Colyseus Cloud and infrastructure dependencies are separate records.
entries.notes: Lightweight engine-neutral authoritative-room benchmark. Pin core and transport independently; research recorded the 0.17.21 uWebSockets transport security fix. Distributed/multi-process scaling must include Redis and operational cost in the frozen manifest. No execution claim.

entries.name: Photon Fusion 2
entries.license: Photon SDK/service use is governed by current Photon licensing, plan and service terms; no open-source redistribution right is inferred by this entry.
entries.notes: Research-time Fusion baseline 2.1.1 with physics addon 2.1.2. Benchmark Server/Host/Shared topology explicitly. Predicted physics resimulation cost is measured on supported clients under lag separately from dedicated-server CPU. Keep gameplay rules portable behind an adapter.

entries.name: Agones
entries.license: Pinned Agones repository is Apache-2.0; Kubernetes/cloud infrastructure, images and third-party integrations have separate terms and costs.
entries.notes: v1.59.0 open ownership/sovereignty reference. Do not make Kubernetes an indie default absent measured scale/cost justification. Managed Agones-based providers must record their actual embedded compatibility version rather than inherit upstream latest.

entries.name: Nitrado GameFabric
entries.license: Commercial service terms, SLA, security, infrastructure and pricing require execution-time review; Agones compatibility does not transfer upstream licensing/capability claims automatically.
entries.notes: Primary managed hosting benchmark. Research-time docs reported managed Agones 1.57.0 while upstream benchmark is 1.59.0; pin provider runtime/integration compatibility independently at execution. Hathora named GameFabric as a migration path when exiting gaming infrastructure.

entries.name: Edgegap
entries.license: Commercial service, SDK/API, infrastructure, data and pricing terms require execution-time review.
entries.notes: Managed low-operations benchmark. Benchmark current Nakama FleetManager integration before custom glue. Marketing location, latency, optimal-placement and savings claims do not become ByJTT evidence without an identical container, player-location manifest and load trace.

entries.name: Microsoft PlayFab Multiplayer
entries.license: Microsoft/PlayFab service, SDK, platform and commercial terms apply; exact title configuration and pricing are execution-time evidence.
entries.notes: Microsoft/Xbox ecosystem benchmark, not portable default. Frozen tests include queues/tickets, team/skill/region rules, timed relaxation/expansion, backfill, export/migration and cost.

entries.name: Unity Matchmaker
entries.license: Unity service/SDK/platform terms apply; Matchmaker is a separate service decision from deprecated direct Multiplay Game Server Hosting.
entries.notes: Current matchmaking candidate only. Research records external hosting-provider integration through Cloud Code after direct Multiplay Hosting support ended. Never conflate Matchmaker continuation with the deprecated direct hosting product.

entries.name: Hathora Cloud
entries.license: Historical service reference only; no new production adoption is permitted by this registry entry.
entries.notes: Reject for new projects. Vendor announcement stated gaming-customer support would continue only through 2026-05-05 after acquisition by Fireworks AI, with GameFabric identified as a migration path. Retain to prevent stale pre-2026 recommendations from resurfacing.

entries.name: Unity Multiplay direct Game Server Hosting
entries.license: Superseded service reference; no new direct-hosting adoption is permitted by this registry entry.
entries.notes: Reject as a new direct hosting option. Unity documentation states direct Multiplay Hosting support concluded 2026-03-31. Unity Matchmaker remains separately benchmarkable with external hosting-provider integration. Retain this record to prevent stale recommendations.
